arguments.content:
import zipfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print('FILES IN ARCHIVE:')
for n in z.namelist():
    print(' ', n)

wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
print('\nSHEETS:')
for s in wb.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheet'):
    print(' ', s.attrib)

# shared strings
ss = []
try:
    sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in sst.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}si'):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        ss.append(text)
except KeyError:
    print('\nNo sharedStrings.xml')

sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
print('\nSHEET DATA (first 30 rows):')
sd = sheet.find('m:sheetData', NS)
for row in list(sd)[:30]:
    r = row.attrib.get('r')
    cells = []
    for c in row:
        ref = c.attrib.get('r')
        t = c.attrib.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', NS)
        f = c.find('m:f', NS)
        is_ = c.find('m:is', NS)
        if f is not None:
            val = 'FORMULA:' + (f.text or '')
        elif t == 's' and v is not None:
            val = 'STR[%s]:%r' % (v.text, ss[int(v.text)])
        elif is_ is not None:
            val = 'INLINE:' + ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        elif v is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            val = ''
        cells.append('%s=%s' % (ref, val))
    print('row', r, ' | '.join(cells))

print('\nDIMENSION:', sheet.find('m:dimension', NS).attrib)
